description: A user who loses the config file and logs in again with the same agent name gets 'New encrypted drive', no warning that an agent with this name exists, and after approval a second drive with the same name plus a second API key under the same agent (Agents page: '2 ACTIVE KEYS'). The old drive is not reconnected and its key is not recovered. The page's 'reconnects to the drive it used before' copy appears only when the CLI still holds the old key.
expected: Tell the user an agent named luis-claude already exists and offer: reconnect (needs backup), or create a new drive.
actual: Silent duplicate: two drives both named luis-claude.
suggested_fix: Show a notice 'An agent named X already exists in this account' with Details.

description: After roughly 20 login starts in an hour the CLI prints only 'Agent Drive refused the login request: slow_down'. The documented limit is 20 per IP per hour; the CLI does not say so, gives no wait time, and 'slow_down' is also the polling term. Users on a shared office or CI IP will hit this on their first try with no recovery path.
expected: 'Too many login attempts from this network. Wait up to an hour or use an API key.'
actual: Agent Drive refused the login request: slow_down
suggested_fix: Map 429 slow_down on device_authorization to a clear message with the wait.

description: The reconnect page is not labeled a reconnect: title 'Connect luis-claude?', summary 'luis-claude · full access' (agent and drive share a name), and only a grey paragraph says 'It reconnects to the drive it used before'.
expected: Title or tag 'Reconnect luis-claude?' and the drive named separately.
actual: Same card as a first connect.

description: Done sentence 'You approved luis-claude to read, write, delete and share luis-claude.' repeats the name; a first-time reader may think it is a bug.
expected: '... the drive luis-claude' as the existing-drive card does.

description: Agents with the same name get same-named drives, so the drive picker later shows two 'luis-claude' options and the Details row 'Drive luis-claude' is ambiguous.
